Package com.miniandmore.app.service

Class ZohoSyncService

java.lang.Object
com.miniandmore.app.service.ZohoSyncService
@Service @Transactional public class ZohoSyncService extends Object
Orchestrates Zoho Books sync: product push/pull, inventory pull, order (sales order + invoice) push, and order status pull. Talks to the real Zoho Books API v3 via ZohoBooksClient.

    • syncProductStockOnly

      public Map<String,Object> syncProductStockOnly(Long productId)
      Reconciles Zoho quantity to the current store stock without pushing names, prices, images, or descriptions. Safe to call after automatic webhooks or admin retries — adjustments are absolute, so a second call with the same stock is a no-op.

    • pullProducts

      @Transactional(propagation=NOT_SUPPORTED) public Map<String,Object> pullProducts(boolean forceFullPull)
      Parameters:
      forceFullPull - when false (the normal case), incremental mode pages every item status from Zoho and skips unchanged rows locally (by last_modified_time) before per-item detail calls — reducing GET /items/{id} traffic, not list pagination. The first-ever pull (no stored cursor yet) always pulls the full active catalog regardless of this flag.

    • ensureInvoicePdfCached

      public String ensureInvoicePdfCached(Long orderId)
      Lazily backfills the cached invoice PDF for orders that synced before this feature existed (or where the initial cache attempt failed). Returns the cached URL, or null if there's no Zoho invoice to fetch yet.
